latin: Post intellectualem ebdomadem ordinandi sunt immediate supermundani dei a partibus uniuersi exempti, et incoordinabiles ad hunc mundum, et secundum causam eum undique circumplectentes.
translation: After the intellectual hebdomad there are to be ranked, immediately, the supermundane gods, exempt from the parts of the universe and not co-ordinable with this world, and embracing it on every side according to cause.
